technical-summary: RSC02 step 2: C++ rewrite of the start-up session owner: ordered helper start with readiness and shared-segment checks, measuring lifecycle, resource derivation with typed inputs, and unwinding of every child. Injected callbacks (power apply/restore, plan, wait, started/ended) use the sealed Callback boundary so any throw becomes a typed failure and cleanup still runs; power hook results are typed Status and a returned error is surfaced; the owner never reports a stopped session whose final record could not be persisted (fail closed). Verified-exit-before-restore is preserved under persistence failure; tests are root-safe.
user-summary-candidate: The C++ serving owner starts helpers, measures and unwinds children safely, and refuses to report a clean stop when the final record was not saved.
